what_this_is: The mail row an account starts with: do-work/mail-sender.mjs copies `settings` into the account's own `mail-settings` record `settings:mail` the first time an email row runs, and from then on reads only the account's row, which its owner edits like any record. `from` is the sender of every email (none here: an account names its own; with none, nothing is sent and the sender says so). `owner` is the account's own address, which a written email copies when `written_email_copies` is `account_owner`. `senders.rows` gives a written email sent for one owner address its own sender. `postal_address` is the physical mailing address a subscription email carries (none here: a subscription email is refused until the account names one). `per_person` limits how many emails one address is sent, by kind (a kind the request names, `default_kind` when it names none), counted from the `mail-sent` records; `sent_log.key_prefix` + the BLAKE3 identity of the lowercased address names each, `sent_log.days` is how long they are kept and `subject_kept_out_for` the kinds kept without their subject (a code's subject carries the code). `proof_names.patterns` are a proof account's own addresses, which are written down and never handed to a provider (`held_for_proofs.not_kept` is what such a send answers). `daily` is how many emails the account's provider takes in a UTC day (`mail-day` records, `daily.key_prefix` + the day): once only `keep_back` remain, only the `kept_for` kinds still go. `providers` says, for each provider row of read-data/message-providers.json, how its refusals read: `error_code` finds the provider's own code in the error its adapter answers (named group `code`); a code in `refused_before_dispatch_codes` was refused before anything went, so its allowance is given back, and any other failure may have sent the email, so it stays counted and is not sent again blindly; `suppression_codes` refuse the address itself; `provider_full_code` says the provider's own day is full, which fills the day. Ported from the older owner's mail settings (per_person, sent_log, held_for_proofs, daily, refused_before_dispatch_codes, from, senders, written_email_copies, subscription, postal_address), its sending binding dropped.
